/* {{pp-template}} */
.glossary dt {
    margin-top: 0.4em;
}

.glossary dt + dt {
    margin-top: -0.2em;
}

/* the inline styles that were defined in {gbq}/{gquote};
   simply use {quote} within {defn}, will work like {gbq} */
.glossary .templatequote {
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: -0.5em;
}
